description: This file implements functionality for handling merge base operations within a Git repository, including finding common ancestors, octopus merges, forking points, and checking ancestor relationships.

methods.name: int show_merge_base(struct commit ** rev,size_t rev_nr,int show_all)
methods.description: Finds and displays the merge bases among specified commits, optionally displaying all merge bases.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_commit_reference(const char * arg)
methods.description: Resolves a commit reference from its string identifier.

methods.name: int handle_independent(int count,const char ** args)
methods.description: Handles the computation and display of commits that are independent (not reachable from each other).

methods.name: int handle_octopus(int count,const char ** args,int show_all)
methods.description: Handles the computation and display of octopus merge bases for multiple commits.

methods.name: int handle_is_ancestor(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Checks if one commit is an ancestor of another.

methods.name: int handle_fork_point(int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Finds the fork point of a reference from the reflog.

methods.name: int cmd_merge_base(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Main command function that parses options and delegates to specific handlers for merge base operations.

ctags.name: cmd_merge_base
ctags.signature: (int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)

ctags.name: handle_octopus
ctags.pattern: /^static int handle_octopus(int count, const char **args, int show_all)$/

ctags.name: show_merge_base
ctags.pattern: /^static int show_merge_base(struct commit **rev, size_t rev_nr, int show_all)$/
